creation: Current explicit FILTER_VALUE absent from static enum; model selects offered governed fields or one current filter target
writeback: choice_handles -> hydrate_choice -> _patch -> native reducer -> SourceValueBindingEvidence / TaskState / IR / Plan
candidate_origin: Current Catalog Pin + governed physical mapping + read-only exact/probe/indexed targeted source observation
J_original: Consumer invoked; used request IDs empty because Draft has no consuming filter. Guard rejects before source reads.
J_final_live: Actual Draft now references request, Consumer obtains and selects the real province value, then malformed initial Filter ADD is rejected.
current_gate: Request IDs consumed, current mentions/roles/owner/scope/mapping and final source revalidation required
retrieval: Exact normalized lookup -> existing bounded probe; if incomplete, indexed parameterized prefix candidates -> model semantic selection -> exact revalidation
bound_reason: Reuse existing exact-source small candidate budget; no case-specific numeric tuning
access_guard: SHOW INDEX + EXPLAIN must prove range/ref/const access on an index whose first field is the selected column
candidate_completeness: Complete for the directional query only, never for the full field; over 8 matches safely rejected
